> **This repository does not accept pull requests.**
>
> A manifest published from here decides which jars Raven Forge downloads and
> runs on a player's machine, and it is signed with a key only the maintainer
> holds. Merging a change to a pack is code distribution, not a docs edit, so
> `main` and `dev` both require an owner review that an outside PR will not get.
>
> Please open an **issue** instead — see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
> Corrections filed as issues get applied faster than a PR that cannot be merged.
>
> Bugs in the launcher belong in
> [raven-forge](https://github.com/whiteravens20/raven-forge/issues).
> Bugs in a mod belong with that mod's author.
